title: Tool-call policy rule (v1)
description: One rule deciding whether an agent may call a tool. Evaluation semantics: a call with no matching rule is denied; if any matching rule denies, the call is denied; otherwise require_human_approval beats allow.

agent_id.description: An agent-identity agent_id, or * for every agent.

tool.description: Tool name, or * for every tool.

conditions.description: All must hold (logical AND) for the rule to match. Empty or absent means the rule always matches.

argument.description: Name of the tool-call argument tested.
